title.narrative: Multi Donor Trust Fund for Food Price Crisis Response Core FPCR Core

description.narrative: "1. Reduce the negative impact of high food prices on the lives of the poor in a timely manner 2. Support governments in the design of sustainable policies that mitigate the adverse impacts of more volatile food prices on poverty 3. Support broad-based growth in productivity and market participation in agriculture to ensure an adequate supply response as partof a sustained improvement in food supply. The above objectives are consistent with on-going emergency relief operations undertaken by other partner agencies. The objectives are also in line with the GFRP's two-pronged approach: just-in-time policy advice to address immediate concerns and; short to medium-run financial assistance. This Food Price Crisis Response Core Multidonor Trust Fund (FCRC MDTF) is scaling-up and co-financing a Facility of USD1.2 billion announced by the Bank to allow fast track activities insupport of countries' response to the food crisis. The overall Facility will be co-financed out of IBRD and IDA f unds as well as donor Trust Funds. The Trust Fund portion of the financing will include the present FCRC MDTF as well as the single-donor TF approved from IBRD Surplus. {see also the Framework Document - for Proposed Loans/Credits/Grants for A Global Food Crisis Response Program (GFRP) - for more detailed Program description}"
